## Supervisor v0.7.2

### Importing students: spreadsheets without supervisor emails
- **Found by your name too:** rows with your name as the supervisor (projects) or academic visitor (placements) are now ticked, as well as rows with your email. Your name is the one in **Settings › Invitations**. Titles, capitals, punctuation and the order of the names don't matter, so "Machado, Dr Gabriel" is found for "Gabriel Machado".
- **Emails from the other sheets:** students are still read from the first sheet, but a list of people with their names and emails on another sheet (such as the SUST supervisors and Ulster supervisors on the second sheet of the SUST allocations) now fills in the emails the first sheet leaves out. This fills in both the SUST supervisor's email and your own, so your rows are found by email as well.
  - Names written without spaces ("HuaXin" for "Hua Xin") are matched.
  - When two people have the same name, the department in brackets after their name, such as "(Mechanical Eng)", is compared with the student's course. If that doesn't tell them apart, the email is left empty rather than guessed.
- **Filter by supervisor:** a new **Filter by** list, in every student import, shows the students of one supervisor (or academic visitor) and ticks them. Use it when your rows aren't found automatically. **You** shows the rows found to be yours, and **Everyone** shows every row without changing what is ticked. It replaces **Show other staff's students**.
- **"Major"** columns are now read as the student's course.

### Notes
- Existing data files open unchanged.
